description: Search departure dates, per-person prices in EUR and the status of each departure across the whole group-trip catalogue. Unlike list_packages and get_package_details, which return "from" prices, this returns dated departures with the price of each. It is STORED data, read from the operators at the time given in asOf, and not a live check: a departure listed as available was available at that time. Departures that have already left are never returned, and neither are trips that have no page on the website. Each departure carries a status: "available" can be offered; "on-request" must be confirmed with the operator before it is promised to a traveller and must be described as "on request"; "closed" cannot be sold and is hidden unless include_unsellable is set. seatsLeft is always null, because no seat count is published from stored data: do not say how many places remain. Prices are per person in EUR and are the operator price. Use this for any question about when a trip runs or what a specific date costs, then confirm the chosen date with check_departure_live before it is promised.

destination.description: Country or city, in English or in any of our languages, matched loosely against countries, cities and trip titles. A name we know is read as its English name, which is repeated under asked. Omit to search everywhere.

from.description: Earliest departure date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. A date before today is read as today.

include_unsellable.description: Include closed departures. Default false. Only set this to explain why a date is unavailable, never to offer one.

limit.description: Maximum trips to return, 1 to 50. Default 20. A number outside 1 to 50 is brought inside it, and the limit used is repeated under asked.

name: check_availability
